name: Tryout
why: Borrowing any shop member's On Recruit plays off the whole shop; the copying leans green.

name: Gather
why: Plain red fuel with a two-part scaling rider; reads as a template, not an idea.

name: Walk-In
why: A free member right now is a big, cheap moment; the rival red gift is a small cost.

name: Promote
why: Trade up with a rival: a real target choice, a sting the victim gets a member back from.

name: Demote
why: Trading down is only good in odd spots (dumping Old Maid, grabbing an ability); often a weak Promote.

name: Initiation
why: Free member up to 8 in round III is a clear burst any seat can use.

name: Body Snatchers
why: Every round you pick which rival member to swap for; the victim gets an equal-cost card back.

name: Volunteer
why: Cheap filler body; fires recruit triggers and counts for red, nothing else.

name: Mentor & Protégés
why: Two members for one buy; cheapest-in-shop is visible, so you can plan it.

name: Proselytizers
why: Steady payoff for red's many recruits; quiet but stacks with Walk-In, Initiation, swaps.

name: Mob
why: Big payoff for the red leader; 12 cost and pure rich-get-richer, hard to swap away.

name: Clerk
why: +1 red per round; forgettable and weaker than a Gather turn.

name: Recruiter
why: Recruits refund red, which feeds more recruits; small but loops in red.

name: Patriarch
why: Plain wide-cult scorer with halving math; fine, not exciting.

name: Foster Parents
why: Turns every swap or poach into +2; links Promote, Demote, Body Snatchers, Poach, Panel.

name: Deprogrammers
why: 3 cost worth 4 and counts 4 red members: a must-buy body; the follower rider rubs it in.

name: Panel
why: A free Promote or Demote on recruit; aiming it is a real choice, wording needs the space text.

name: Loyalists
why: Clean counter to red swaps, but it also blocks its owner's own swaps, a gotcha.

name: Sleep In
why: Big purple for going last; the token rules take a read but the hold-or-go call is real.

name: Hold Up
why: Skip the next turn, even yours: a visible block the victim shrugs off, with timing to read.

name: Right Away
why: Small purple and a double turn; useful to grab two spots, rarely a big moment.

name: Last Call
why: Pays per minion held back and fights for Went last; rich decision, several moving parts.

name: Crunch Time
why: Three turns in a row: few words, big change to the snake.

name: Overtime
why: An extra minion in round III is simple and always welcome.

name: Courier
why: Snake ends and Right Away/Crunch Time all pay a full rainbow; a clear purple engine.

name: Night Watch
why: Pays when rivals take the Goes Last token; needs the token rules to read.

name: Night Owls
why: An extra minion each round from II; strong but pricey at 8.

name: Early Birds
why: Cheap answer to Hold Up and Bouncers; a counter card, quiet when nobody skips.

name: Bouncers
why: Recruit and two rivals wait: a felt moment with a timing choice.

name: Bell Ringer
hardFail: needs tracking a table can't do (whether the token was placed before a skip) and can't be read cold
why: Unreadable trigger chain; nobody can say when it fires.

name: Gossip
why: Every skip, including empty-hand passes, pays; ties Hold Up and Bouncers together.

name: Timekeeper
why: Generic per-color-member scorer shared with other colors; nothing purple about it.

name: Closer
why: Placing last pays +4 and fits Went last; Sleep In, Last Call, Night Owls feed it.

name: Hot Streak
why: Big once-a-game cash-in for a chain of turns; counting the streak is fiddly.

name: Picket Line
why: Taxes rivals on purple spaces; 4 cost worth 3 is cheap, effect small, same shape as High Society.

name: Toast
why: Big silver with a smaller gift to all; fits giving, feeds rivals' silver contest.

name: Polish
why: Clean conversion; useful, but conversion is yellow's job more than silver's.

name: Party Gifts
why: Pay rivals silver for followers; who gets it and the silver contest make it a real call.

name: Potluck
why: Everyone trades a resource for silver; rivals choose what to give, a fair small exchange.

name: Sweet Talk
why: Silver plus conversion; overlaps Polish.

name: Largesse
why: Up to 10 silver to rivals in round III for followers, with the silver contest at stake.

name: Godparent
why: Give a member away for its cost in followers; plays with Martyrs and Old Maid.

name: Hostesses
why: Automatic small gift each round; no decision once bought.

name: Caterer
why: Pays on any gift; unclear whether rivals' gifts count, otherwise a tidy silver link.

name: Guest of Honor
why: Every round a cheap member becomes +4; combos Martyrs, Volunteer, Old Maid; maybe too strong at 3.

name: Toastmaster
why: +1 follower per silver space; forgettable.

name: Envy
hardFail: relies on a rival having more silver than you
why: Pays only when a rival holds more silver than you.

name: Debutantes
why: Doubling silver once is a big timed moment before the silver contest.

name: Smooth Talkers
why: 11-cost convenience; silver as any color helps whoever is already rich.

name: Charity Ball
why: Fires on nearly every rival recruit; a quiet follower faucet that is close to must-buy.

name: Creditor
why: Take 2 followers from a chosen rival who gets 3 silver; aimable at the leader.

name: Debt Collectors
why: A one-time take from everyone; reads more magenta than silver's giving.

name: High Society
why: Paid when rivals visit silver; Toast and Potluck draw them in.

name: Harvest
why: The plain any-color anchor; clean.

name: Leaders' Tax
why: Reads where rivals sit; pick the crowded color, small payout.

name: New Blood
why: Rider for a new color recruit; conditional and wordy.

name: Housewarming
why: Free new-color member up to 5: clear, strong, fits going broad.

name: Melting Pot
why: Pays for breadth you built; a visible payoff.

name: Makeover
why: Rearrange for full sets in round III; tidy, small.

name: Gardeners
why: Fills gaps each round; helps the broke player, one of four similar round-start yellow cards.

name: Duty Collector
why: Pays off rivals' recruits in your colors; condition takes a second read.

name: Tourist
why: Followers per color held, twice-fired; rewards breadth well.

name: Seamstress
why: Doubling full sets once can swing the yellow contest, but what doubling means is unclear.

name: Dyer
why: Tourist's shape paying yellow instead; a weaker sibling.

name: Meddler
why: Twist rivals' colors to wreck their sets; fiddly but it bites the full-sets contest.

name: Drifters
why: Cheap wild body that plugs whichever color you need; a good way-in member.

name: Big Tent
why: Exactly one per color is a crisp build goal that shapes every recruit.

name: Caravan
why: Fourth round-start per-color card; 9 cost, repeats Tourist and Dyer.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
why: Yellow fills full-set gaps; simple helper for the yellow contest.

name: Savings
why: Blue plus an optional bury before recruiting; fine fuel.

name: Out of Style
why: Wipe a color from the shop to deny rivals; a visible block.

name: Peek
why: See and stack the pile, then recruit from it; strong, a few steps.

name: Recruit Twice
why: Two buys in one turn; clean.

name: Bury
why: Deny a shop card for half its cost; a real hate-draft.

name: Spree
why: Three recruits in round III: a burst a trailing player can grab.

name: Hawker
why: Rivals decide to pay you or let you take it free; a real choice, many words.

name: Patroness
why: Pays on every bury, which blue does a lot; per member or per event is unclear.

name: Snobs
why: Generic per-color-member scorer.

name: Window Shopper
why: Bury two picks and take their colors; shop control with a small payout.

name: Shopaholics
why: Two buys every turn snowballs for whoever is richest; pricey, hard to swap.

name: Scavenger
hardFail: asks its owner to choose during a rival's turn
why: Owner decides to recruit on a rival's turn.

name: Window Dressers
why: Cheap 3-member body for the members contest; the bury is a small shop reset.

name: Doormen
why: Strong member swap on a rival each round; many words and price rules.

name: Regular
why: +1 blue on follower buys; forgettable.

name: Trendsetters
why: Each recruit buries one; links to Patroness, cheap 3-member body.

name: Critic
why: Pays when rivals take blue members; passive.

name: Help Yourself
why: Steal and split as you like; aimable at the leader.

name: Stash
why: The same space as Allowance and Gather; nothing magenta about it.

name: Lie Low
why: Small steal plus a round of safety; a clear defensive call.

name: Heist
why: Take 3 followers outright; simple and aimable at the leader.

name: Shake Down
why: The victim chooses their own punishment; feels bad.

name: Poach
why: Take any rival member free in round III; a big, clear moment.

name: Cutpurse
why: Automatic small theft from the richest; no decision.

name: Accomplice
why: Cheap, clear steal 3; a good way-in member.

name: Grifter
why: Steal scales with members; 8 cost for a one-off.

name: Second-Story Man
why: Steal right before contests to flip one; a sharp timing weapon.

name: Desperado
why: Bigger steals for the trailing player; a true catch-up card.

name: Extortionist
why: Cutpurse at double; repeats a sibling.

name: Bodyguards
why: Clean answer to all theft.

name: Double Agent
why: A trade that dumps an 8-cost worth-1 on a rival; reads more red.

name: Kidnapper
why: Takes a rival's member every round from round I; the victim feels robbed.

name: Shoplifter
why: Every recruit steals one; small, stacks with recruit-heavy turns.

name: Fence
why: Pays you when robbed; a soft counter to magenta.

name: Allowance
why: Template shared with Gather and Stash; nothing white about it.

name: Splurge
why: Pay big for followers on a recruit; the round III rate isn't stated.

name: Exchange
why: Resources into followers at 2 each; clear conversion.

name: Farewell
why: Cast out a member for its cost; with Martyrs it pays twice.

name: Estate Sale
why: Farewell for white; a smaller sibling.

name: Cash In
why: Cash a white pile without using your buy; pays off Misers and Magpie timing.

name: Recluse
why: Pays for staying small; the white idea in one line, fair catch-up.

name: Barker
why: An extra follower buy with each member; strong, not clearly white.

name: Heiresses
why: 9 cost for one burst of white; rarely worth it.

name: Brokers
why: +1 on white follower spaces; cheap 3-member body.

name: Misers
why: Hold white to game end versus Cash In now; a real call.

name: Raiders
why: Steal 4 followers once, paying 2; strong, borrows magenta's job.

name: Cashier
why: Cash In on a member; already doable with the space.

name: Money Changers
why: White on every follower buy at the table; fires often, wording is busy.

name: Martyrs
why: Pays when it leaves; links Farewell, Guest of Honor, Godparent, swaps and theft.

name: Old Money
why: Rewards white members in a color about having few; generic scorer.

name: Magpie
why: Everything into white once, setting up Cash In or Misers.

name: Build Up
why: Plain green anchor.

name: Echo
why: Copy the previous action: reads the table every turn.

name: Reprise
why: Repeat your own best space; clear.

name: Sample
why: Use a rival's On Recruit; aims at the table.

name: Cover
why: Copy an open space; reach without blocking.

name: Greatest Hits
why: Fires all your On Recruits again; pays the built engine.

name: Song Request
why: A free action each round from a rival's space; strong, simple.

name: Impersonator
why: Borrow any rival ability; you have to keep track of what it copies.

name: Impressionist
why: Paid on anyone's copy; links green spaces at the table.

name: Wallflower
why: Doubles copied gains; a big engine piece for a rich green player.

name: Fan Club
why: Copy the leader's space; built-in catch-up.

name: Roadie
why: Small green per copy, scaling with green members.

name: Stunt Double
why: Do this turn's space twice; timing matters, close to Reprise.

name: Tribute Band
why: Do a whole rival's round once; huge, 14 cost, timing unclear.

name: Doppelganger
why: Become your best member; good with strong ones.

name: Agents
why: Stops rivals copying you; a counter that sits oddly in green.

name: Encore
why: Double your next On Recruit; you must remember it's armed.

name: Party Crasher
why: Take a blocked space once; breaks the draft for a big turn.

name: Alchemists
why: Any resource pays any cost; convenience, worth 3.

name: Extra Hand
why: 9 cost for one extra minion; Overtime does it as a space.

name: Line Cutters
why: 2 cost, worth 3, first every round: cancels catch-up turn order; must-buy.

name: Old Maid
why: A poison card you pass on via Promote, Godparent or Demote; fun if you can dump it.

name: Dabblers
why: Counts as 2 of every color; needs the ruling to read.

name: Cheerleaders
why: Pays contest winners more; rich get richer.

name: Victors
hardFail: plural name on a single member (worth 1)
why: Contest winners get more of that color; plural name for one member.

name: Anarchist
why: Swap any two members anywhere each round; powerful, kingmaking risk.

name: Spoilsport
why: Cancel a contest you can't win; a clear block on the leader.

name: Con Men
why: Steal 5 is magenta's job on a guest.

name: Sore Loser
why: Shut out of contests, take 5 from the top winner; catch-up.
